summary: The right words arrive with surprising ease the moment you stop trying to make a conversation flawless and simply say what you actually mean.
body: The right words arrive with surprising ease the moment you stop trying to make a conversation flawless and simply say what you actually mean. When the Moon trines Mercury, feelings and thought cooperate, helping you explain what shifted, what bothered you, or what you require next without getting lost in every possible interpretation of how it might land. You can be emotionally honest without becoming obscure, and direct without forcing the other person to decode everything underneath your sentence. Say the useful thing while the language is flowing.
